children: DeFi Development grew its SOL treasury to 2,388,923 SOL and set up a $300 million CHAD ATM to fund further SOL accumulation.
Treasury rose by 55,491 SOL to 2,388,923 SOL and SOL equivalents (2% increase since Aug 27, 2026).
Company expects treasury SOL to be deployed via staking, validator and on‑chain treasury infrastructure.
Established an ATM for up to $300 million of Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD).
Intends to issue CHAD shares at or above $10.00 per share; net proceeds primarily to fund additional SOL purchases.
Company says ATM expands capital flywheel to raise capital, accumulate SOL, generate yield and compound SOL per share.
